text: P02 plan. Flow in src/solve/loop.ts: parse problem -> scratch worktree on synthe/solve-<name>-<n> -> guards on baseline (fail = exit 1) -> baseline measure -> rounds: proposer -> edits -> guards -> measure -> decide -> commit or reset -> history. Stop: empty proposals, max_rounds, max_calls, 3 rounds keep nothing. Owners: h05 loop.ts + cli/solve.ts; h06 scratch.ts + report.ts; h07 measure.ts + decide.ts; h08 history.ts. loop.ts calls modules only through the types in src/solve/types.ts, so each owner can land alone. Until a module lands, loop.ts tests use small fakes.
P02 verdict: medium. The loop is plain glue; the risk is the interfaces between 4 owners. Keep the module signatures in types.ts stable; post a note before a change.
